step.content: {"order":"CD-420442","goal":"Tell Uma that Bahn is asking the buyer to pay invoice OV-2026-3318 and send the signed release to utlamning@orvendin.example, that no driver will leave before they confirm, and confirm the 15:00 check and 10:00 pickup tomorrow. turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Utlämningen, Uma Aldermere på Orvendin Cars Stockholm, hej! Vad gäller det?
turns.translation: Collection desk, Uma Aldermere at Orvendin Cars Stockholm, hello! What's it regarding?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hej Uma, jag är Bahns digitala assistent och ringer om Bentley Continental GT, order CD-420442. Bahn ber köparen betala faktura OV-2026-3318 och skicka den signerade utlämningen till utlämning@orvendin.example, och ingen förare åker innan ni bekräftat.
turns.translation: Hi Uma, I'm Bahn's digital assistant calling about the Bentley Continental GT, order CD-420442. Bahn is asking the buyer to pay invoice OV-2026-3318 and send the signed release to utlamning@orvendin.example, and no driver will leave before you confirm.

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Hej! Ja, det stämmer, men adressen är utlamning@orvendin.example, utan ä. Bentleyn står klar, men vi har en spärr på den eftersom fakturan inte är betald, och ingen undertecknad fullmakt har kommit. Skicka ingen förare innan ni har hört från oss.
turns.translation: Hi! Yes, that's right, but the address is utlamning@orvendin.example, without the ä. The Bentley is ready, but we have a hold on it because the invoice isn't paid, and no signed release has arrived. Don't send a driver until you've heard from us.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tack Uma, jag noterar adressen utlamning@orvendin.example, utan ä, och att ingen förare skickas innan ni bekräftat. Stämmer det att vi då kör med kontroll klockan 15:00 och hämtning klockan 10:00 i morgon?
turns.translation: Thanks Uma, I note the address utlamning@orvendin.example, without ä, and that no driver is sent before you confirm. Is it correct that we then go with the check at 15:00 and pickup at 10:00 tomorrow?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Ja, nästan: syns både betalningen och fullmakten vid kontrollen klockan 15 i dag kan föraren hämta bilen i morgon klockan 10. Kommer de senare är nästa kontroll i morgon klockan 10, och då kan bilen lämnas ut tidigast klockan 11.
turns.translation: Yes, almost: if both the payment and the release show at the 15:00 check today, the driver can collect the car tomorrow at 10:00. If they come later, the next check is tomorrow at 10:00, and the car can be handed over at 11:00 at the earliest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tack, då har jag det: syns både betalning och fullmakt klockan 15 i dag hämtar föraren klockan 10 i morgon, annars blir nästa kontroll klockan 10 i morgon och utlämning tidigast 11. Ingen förare åker innan ni bekräftat. Tack för hjälpen, Uma, hej då!
turns.translation: Thanks, so I have it: if both payment and release show at 15:00 today, the driver picks up at 10:00 tomorrow, otherwise the next check is 10:00 tomorrow and handover at 11:00 at the earliest. No driver leaves before you confirm. Thanks for your help, Uma, goodbye!

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Precis så, tack själv! Efter kontrollen klockan 15 mejlar vi er om spärren är hävd. Hej då!
turns.translation: Exactly, thanks to you! After the 15:00 check we'll e-mail you whether the hold is lifted. Goodbye!

steps.content:
I called Orvendin and told Uma about the plan. She confirmed the hold stays until the invoice payment and the signed release both show at the 15:00 Stockholm time check. If they do, the driver collects the car tomorrow at 10:00. If not, the next check is tomorrow at 10:00 and the earliest handover is 11:00. The release goes to utlamning@orvendin.example, spelled without the ä. Orvendin will email after the 15:00 check, and I set a callback for 15:15 Stockholm time.

Kasper is told not to set off until the release is on file, and he said he will wait. I did not contact the customer: a person still has to send the message asking Vekarino to settle the invoice and send the release.

decision.why: Sofie talked it through with the agent: Vekarino signs the release once Orvendin's invoice is paid, so she asks Vekarino to pay and send the signed release to utlamning@orvendin.example, as Aino did on the Ferrari.

lesson.text: Orvendin Cars Stockholm: when the seller has put a hold on the car, ask the customer to settle with the seller and send the signed release. Sofie decided so.
